title: FinRobot Fact Table Row
description: One row in the verified fact table. Maps each extracted claim to a verification result.

period.description: Fiscal year or period string. May be empty if period was not extractable.

claimed_value.description: Human-readable value from the report (value_display from claim), e.g. '$60.9 billion'.

verified_value.description: Primary-source value as a display string, e.g. '$26.97B'. Empty if verification_status is not 'verified' or 'incorrect'.

source.description: Human-readable source label, e.g. 'SEC EDGAR 10-K', 'FMP ratios FY2023'. Empty if not applicable.

source_tier.description: Source tier (1=SEC/exchange, 2=company IR, 3=aggregator/FMP, 4=news, 5=LLM). Planned for PR2.

verification_status.description: Result of verification. SOURCE_CONFLICT means multiple sources disagree beyond tolerance. 'incorrect' may be a period attribution artifact — do not interpret as confirmed hallucination without manual review.

notes.description: First 200 chars of claim_text (extraction context). Not a structured audit note.

verified_value_alt.description: Secondary source value when verification_status=SOURCE_CONFLICT. Empty otherwise. Planned for PR3.

source_alt.description: Secondary source label when verification_status=SOURCE_CONFLICT. Empty otherwise.

conflict_details.description: JSON-serialized object {tier1_value, tier3_value, delta_pct, tolerance} when verification_status=SOURCE_CONFLICT. Null/empty otherwise.
